newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CEG and Riogas base price at 560 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CEG and Riogas base price at 560 mln reais.

text.p: A minimum price of 560 million reais ($523.4 million) has been set for the July 14 privatization auction of Rio de Janeiro state gas company Companhia Estadual de Gas (CEG) and piped gas distributor Riogas, a state official said.

The state finance department spokesman said the full tender documents for the sell-off would be published Friday and include details on the amount of privatization bonds that investors would be allowed to use to pay for the shares.

The Rio state government will sell 58.87 percent of CEG's voting capital together with an 83.6 percent voting stake in Riogas, a company created earlier this year to distribute piped gas in the state.
The shares will be sold at a closed-envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange. ((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
